obligations.detail: sourceEnergyRe_excursions_of_zeroSum: for nonzero zero-sum z the source energy e_{Dz} exceeds |z|^2/pi^2 and drops below -|z|^2/pi^2 on (0,1).

evenBoundaryFlat_source_exactInertia / oddBoundaryFlat_source_exactInertia: for every 0 < omega <= 1/2 and K >= 2 the elementary source form on the even (odd) boundary-flat carrier is nondegenerate with exact inertia (K/2, (K-1)/2, 0) ((K-1)/2, K/2, 0). Proof: Andreief identity, signed leading minors (-1)^{r(r-1)/2} D_r > 0 in the cosine-power carrier basis (andreiefSign_mul_det_gram_pos), Jacobi split by Cramer vectors (jacobi_alternating_split), carrier Gram = Andreief convolution (sourceSesq_evenCarrier_cosPow, sourceSesq_oddCarrier_cosPow). Elementary sourceMatrix only; omega <= 1/2 (aperture a <= pi) is used and is not removable. Moment-filtered carriers (post-284 M18) are not covered.
exists_sourceDegenerate_of_half_neg / parityBoundaryFlat_sourceDegenerate: some omega in (1/2,1) makes the carrier source form PSD and degenerate. Zeros of source compression only.
At least as many passages (with multiplicity) as half-aperture negative eigenvalues: DERIVED via continuous eigenvalue branches, not formalized.
sum_normSq_le_four_mul (and strict form): sum|z|^2 <= 4 sum n^2|z_n|^2 on the zero-sum carrier, uniform in K, via the telescoped mass 4 - 4/(2K+1). Contact gap delta|v|^2 <= 4|H(v)||M4(v)|.
Optimal constant on the whole zero-sum carrier decreases to 1/4 numerically (0.2513 at K=80). Not proved; no sharpness claimed on the even legal carrier.

Canonical instance of the rank-one secular algebra with the actual A_L, B_L, D, g, H_L: resolvent ray, relative determinant, ker A_L = span(x_L) iff H_L(x_L) = 1, Ward identity, contact phase lock Re(conj S M4) = gamma|S|^2 > 0, approximate-contact bounds, M4 gauge. D is not assumed unitary. H_L(x_L) = 1 is contact-equivalent and is never used as an independent opposite-side input.
abs_sourceEnergyRe_index_sub_le (M_K = (2+4 pi K)(2K+1)K^2) and exists_sourceNegativeWindow (e < -|z|^2/(2 pi^2) on |omega - omega_-| <= 1/(2 pi^2 M_K), window inside (0,1)).

exists_prime_physicalSecondPrimeTerm_pos_and_two_neg: for L >= pi^2 M_K log 2 some prime 2 < p < e^L has a strictly positive physical second-test summand -(Lambda(p)(log p)^2/sqrt p) e(1 - log p/L) and the p = 2 summand is strictly negative. Individual summands only; no statement about the prime sum.

For real lambda below the odd Rayleigh bottom: (A_L - lambda) v_L(lambda) = (1 - T_L(lambda)) D^-1 g, det(A_L - lambda) = det(B_L - lambda)(1 - T_L(lambda)), lambda is an even eigenvalue iff T_L(lambda) = 1, and the even eigenspace at lambda has finrank <= 1 (canonical_finrank_eigenspace_le_one). T_L(lambda) = 1 is the eigenvalue condition itself.

one_sub_canonicalSecularFunction_eq: below the odd Rayleigh bottom 1 - T_L(lambda) = prod_i(a_i - lambda)/prod_k(b_k - lambda) over the eigenvalues of A_L and B_L. canonical_secular_hasDerivAt_root: at every even eigenvalue a_j below the odd floor T_L'(a_j) = prod_{i != j}(a_i - a_j)/prod_k(b_k - a_j). canonical_secular_root_slope_sign: that slope is nonzero with sign (-1)^{#{i : a_i < a_j}}, i.e. (-1)^(j-1) for the roots numbered increasingly. Fixed L only: no lambda-monotonicity away from the roots and no aperture-derivative sign is claimed.
canonical_contact_overlap: at an even contact with positive odd bottom, <x_L, D^-1 g> * S_L(D^-1 B_L^-1 B_L^-1 g) = |x_L|^2, so both factors are nonzero, and |x_L| <= |D^-1 g| |S_L(w_L)|. Sign-free.

canonical_contact_overlap_pos: at an even contact (S_L(x_L) = 1) with 0 <= even Rayleigh bottom and 0 < odd Rayleigh bottom, S_L(w_L) and <x_L, D^-1 g> are real and strictly positive. Route: coercive symmetric maps have real positive determinants, so 1 - T_L(lambda) > 0 for lambda < 0; the resolvent identity and an elementary limit lambda -> 0-. A_L positive semidefinite is a hypothesis (first-crossing geometry), never inferred from T <= 1; nothing asserts that a contact exists.

Swapped rank-one instance A D^-1 - D^-1 B = (-D^-1 g) (x) (H o D^-1). With positive even bottom: ker B_L lies on span(D A_L^-1 D^-1 g) (finrank <= 1), B_L singular iff S_L(A_L^-1 D^-1 g) = -1, det B_L = det A_L (1 + S_L(A_L^-1 D^-1 g)). Tied: A_L z = 0 and B_L y = 0 imply S_L(z) <g, y> = 0. Identities only; no branch is excluded.
No even-first, odd-first, tied, fresh-born or interior branch is excluded. The contact criteria above are equivalent to the contacts themselves.

productionContactF04DerivativeAuthority_of_lt_log_two: for 0 < L < log 2 and every K, all three fields of ProductionContactF04DerivativeAuthority L K hold for the actual canonical even compressed family: E'_z = A_L[(t/L^2) e'_z(1 - t/L)], E''_z + (2/L) E'_z = A_L[(t^2/L^4) e''_z(1 - t/L)], Re<z, A'_L w> = A_L[mixed test]. Proof: real M05 identity with no prime terms below log 2, Leibniz under the moving aperture with t rho(t) regularized, endpoint cancellation via wCorrection' = e^{-L/2} rho(L), e'_z(0) = 0 on boundary-flat vectors, symmetric polarization for the mixed field. The single cCorrection repair is the one inside canonicalSourceMatrix; nothing is added twice.

productionContactF04DerivativeAuthority_of_pos: all three F04 fields hold at every L > 0 and every K. Over a fixed range of q the prime staircase is a sum of terms switched on by log q <= L; each entering term has zero value and slope at its seam because e_z(0) = e'_z(0) = 0 (energy) and e'_z(0) = e''_z(0) = 0 (first channel) on boundary-flat vectors, so it is differentiable there (hasDerivAt_ite_le). Statement: forall K L, 0 < L -> ProductionContactF04DerivativeAuthority L K, the exact post-284 premise structure, with no other hypothesis. All ten Zeta23/CCM consumers have F04-free instances here (*_of_pos, *_unconditional); the eight RHRC claim-contract wrappers still take hF04 as a parameter until the registry is rebound. Derivative transport only: no sign, no contact exclusion.

GeneratedStrictEvenContact.secondPhysicalValue_eq_two_mul_responseCost / secondPhysicalValue_nonneg: at a stationary generated strict-even contact the complete second physical value (pole, archimedean and every prime up to e^{L*}) equals 2<A w, w> >= 0 for the stationary response w.

production_stationary_saturation, production_stationary_remainder_pos, completed_production_frontier and inherited_completed_production_frontier of FirstCrossingGeneratedStrictEvenFrontier now hold with no F04 hypothesis (*_unconditional). The stationary production remainder is strictly positive at every stationary generated strict-even contact; excluding that saturation (OBS-060O) stays OPEN.

productionSecondDerivativePhysicalValue_eq_neg_primeFreeSecondTest (Q-F04: E''_z + (2/L) E'_z = -(2 pi)^2/L^4 Q_K(L, z) for 0 < L < log 2), productionContactEulerCurvature_le (<= -(M/L^2)(1 - 2 pi^2 L (2K+1) K^2), M = sum|z_i|^2) and productionContactEulerCurvature_neg (< 0 for nonzero z on 0 < L < eps_K = 1/(2 pi^2 (2K+1) K^2)). Even boundary-flat carrier only.

GeneratedStrictEvenContact.firstVariation_ne_zero_of_lt_primeFreeRadius and fresh_of_lt_primeFreeRadius: a generated strict-even contact with L* < eps_K is not stationary, hence fresh-born. Possibly vacuous: numerically the even ground is positive on the whole prime-free window for K = 2..16, so no generated contact is known to lie below eps_K. Excludes nothing above eps_K and says nothing about odd-first, tied or interior branches.

On the even boundary-flat carrier the Euler-corrected form E'' + (2/L)E' stays negative definite up to about L = 0.55 (K = 2), 0.42 (K = 3), 0.38 (K = 4), 0.36 (K = 5), 0.30 (K = 16), against eps_K = 2.5e-3 .. 2.3e-5. Floating point only.

psi_sub_self_eq_weightedRemainder: for real x >= 1, psi(x) - x = 1 + sqrt(x) R(x) - (1/2) int_1^x R(t)/sqrt(t) dt with R(x) = sum_{n <= x} Lambda(n)/sqrt(n) - 2 sqrt(x) (Mathlib Abel summation, right-continuous floor convention). abs_psi_sub_self_sub_one_le: |R| <= M on [1, x] gives |psi(x) - x - 1| <= 2 M sqrt(x). Firewall: R = O_eps(x^eps) for every eps > 0 would be RH-strength; it is never assumed. Unconditional; no sign or size of R.

isGreatest_weightedRemainder: sup_{[1,X]} R = max_{1 <= m <= floor X} R(m), attained. isGLB_weightedRemainder: inf_{[1,X]} R = min_{1 <= m <= floor X} (W_m - 2 sqrt(min(m+1, X))), stated as a greatest lower bound because it can be a left limit before a jump. Finite arithmetic; the oscillation Omega(L) of (71.2) is now a finite computation. No bound on Omega(L) is claimed.

gronwall_lower_bound / gronwall_pos: y' >= -C y on (a, b) with C continuous gives y(t) >= y(a) exp(-int_a^t C). canonical_evenBottom_pos_of_gronwall (CONDITIONAL): odd bottom > 0 on [L0, L1], even bottom > 0 at L0, det A_L = det B_L y(L), and y' >= -C y imply the even bottom stays positive on [L0, L1]. The Gronwall inequality is a hypothesis; it is the OPEN M32 target. Not an exclusion theorem.

cubic_schur_third_deriv: for C^3 families a, b, H (real inner product space; complex Hermitian through Re<.,.>) with H(t0) invertible, R = H(t0)^-1 and b(t0) = 0, s = a - <b, H^-1 b> has s'''(t0) = a''' - 3<b', R b''> - 3<b'', R b'> + 6<b', R H' R b'>. cubic_schur_third_deriv_response: for symmetric H(t0), s''' = a''' - 6<b', R b''> + 6<R b', H' R b'> = a''' + 6<b'', w> + 6<H' w, w> with w = -R b'. cubic_schur_third_nonpos_of_right_negative: a zero of order three that turns negative to the right has s''' <= 0 (necessary only).
<F''' z, z> = -(2 pi)^2 A_L[t^3 e'_{Dz}(1 - t/L)]/L^6 - 12 C/L and the conditional necessary inequality need moving-aperture C^3 transport of the full source on a neighborhood; not formalized.
No independent continuous or integrable C_K with T_L' <= C_K(L)(1 - T_L) is known for the canonical operator. C_K may not be built from T'/(1 - T), det A_L, assumed absence of contacts, or RH.
